questions.question: A thyroid section shows tall follicular cells. This is suggestive of:
questions.explanation: Correct answer: B. Increased thyroid activity

questions.question: A histological section of parathyroid gland shows large eosinophilic cells with numerous mitochondria. These cells are most likely:
Accidental removal of parathyroid glands during thyroid surgery may lead to:
Thyroid follicles are lined mainly by:
questions.explanation: Correct answer: B. Simple cuboidal epithelium

questions.question: The height of follicular cells depends mainly on:
questions.explanation: Correct answer: B. Functional activity of the gland

questions.question: The colloid inside thyroid follicles mainly contains:
Which of the following is a characteristic feature of an active thyroid follicle?
options: Tall follicular cells with irregular margined colloid
questions.explanation: Correct answer: C. Tall follicular cells with irregular margined colloid

questions.question: The apical surface of follicular cells is characterized by:
Thyroid follicular cells secrete:
questions.explanation: Correct answer: B. T3 and T4

questions.question: Parafollicular cells are also known as:
Which organelle is particularly abundant in thyroid follicular cells due to their protein synthesis activity?
questions.explanation: Correct answer: A. Rough endoplasmic reticulum

questions.question: Which of the following is TRUE about thyroid follicles?
options: All follicles have the same size
They are surrounded by a rich network of fenestrated capillaries
They are lined by stratified squamous epithelium
questions.explanation: Correct answer: B. They are surrounded by a rich network of fenestrated capillaries
